ComicHub User Guide

Community Forum

Learn how to create an account, browse categories, search discussions, start topics, reply to other members, and use member profiles.

ContentsForum OverviewCreating an AccountSigning InNavigationBrowsing CategoriesSearchingStarting a TopicReplyingProfiles & MembersTopic ToolsForum TipsQuick Reference

1. Forum Overview

ComicHub is the community discussion area for Comic Zone users. You can browse discussions, ask for help, share Smart Lists, read guides, and talk with other members.

The top of the forum contains the discussion search box and Sign In and Sign Up controls.

2. Creating an Account

Click Sign Up in the top right of the forum.

  1. Choose a Username.
  2. Enter your Email Address.
  3. Create a Password.
  4. Enter it again under Confirm Password.
  5. Click Create Account.

Already have an account? Choose Sign In instead.

3. Signing In

Enter the email address and password associated with your account.

Once signed in, the controls change to show New Topic, your avatar, and the Log out button.

4. Forum Navigation

SectionPurpose
HomeCategories and recent discussions.
TrendingDiscussions currently attracting activity.
MembersBrowse members and their profiles.

5. Browsing Categories

The home page lists discussion categories as cards. Click a card to filter Recent Discussions to that category.

Examples include Guides, Smart Lists, General, and Support. Use Clear filter to return to all recent discussions.

6. Searching Discussions

Use the Search discussions… box at the top of the forum to find topics by keyword.

Tip: Search before creating a new topic. A question may already have an answer or an active discussion.

7. Starting a Topic

Sign in and click New Topic.

  1. Give the topic a clear Title.
  2. Choose the appropriate Category.
  3. Write your post in Message.
  4. Click Post Topic.

Use Support for help, Smart Lists for Smart List discussions/sharing, Guides for guide content, and General for topics outside the other categories.

8. Reading and Replying to a Topic

Open any topic from the discussion list to read the original post and its replies.

Use Reply to add to the conversation. Use Quote when responding to a particular post. Discussions can also include shared files, such as Comic Zone .cbl reading-list files.

9. Your Profile and Members

Click your avatar or name to open your personal profile. Your profile provides a summary of your ComicHub activity and account information.

The profile shows your avatar, username and role, along with your number of Topics, Replies, Reputation, and the month and year you Joined. Your bio appears beneath these statistics, and your recent topics are listed farther down the page.

When viewing your own profile, click Edit Profile to update the profile information available to you.

You can also choose Members from the main navigation to browse other ComicHub users.

Member cards can show the user's name, role, and forum activity. Select a member to view that user's profile.

10. Topic and Post Tools

ControlPurpose
ReplyAdd a response.
QuoteRespond while referring to a specific post.
ShareShare the discussion.
SubscribeFollow the topic for future activity.
EditModify a post when permitted.
DeleteRemove a post when permitted.

11. Forum Tips

  • Search before starting a duplicate topic.
  • Use a descriptive topic title.
  • Choose the category that best fits the discussion.
  • For support questions, include what you expected, what happened, and steps that reproduce the problem.
  • Keep related replies in the existing discussion.
  • Use the Smart Lists category to discuss and share Comic Zone reading lists and related files.

12. Quick Reference

Create an account: Sign Up → Username → Email → Password → Confirm Password → Create Account
Sign in: Sign In → Email → Password → Sign In
Browse: Home → Category Card → Recent Discussions
Search: Search discussions… → Keywords → Open Topic
Post: New Topic → Title → Category → Message → Post Topic
Reply: Open Topic → Reply or Quote → Write response
Profiles: Avatar/Name or Members → Select Member
